template.name: bzm - Blazor Recorder
template.description:
Record a Blazor Server circuit

JMeter configuration

The plan has a thread group, a View Results Tree inside it, and the Blazor recorder. The recorder listens on port 8888.

Browser configuration

Point the browser HTTP and SOCKS proxy at the machine running JMeter, port 8888. Do not bypass the application host. Trust the certificate at ~/.jmeter/blazor-recorder/ca.crt, then open the app over http or https. HTTPS is recorded as HTTP/1.1, including a site that prefers HTTP/2.

A window stays on top while you record. Group the steps into a Simple Controller from that window. Press Stop recording, or close the window, when you are done. Each server is stored as ${SERVER_1}, ${SERVER_2}, and so on.
